blind.description: A square, low stone platform or dais built with stylized chiseled stone masonry. The top surface consists of six large rectangular flagstones arranged in a 2x3 grid, framed by a recessed border of dark slate-grey rectangular tiles, which is in turn bordered by raised, rounded stone curbing along the edges and rounded corner bollard-like stones. The sides are formed from two horizontal tiers of stone blocks. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and clean with stylized, hand-painted bevelled edges. The underside sits flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: A square platform divided into six inner flagstone rectangles (a 3-column by 2-row layout), enclosed by a darker inset border strip and an outer raised stone rim with rounded corner caps.
blind.height_vs_figure: Very low, roughly 1/5 the height of the figure (around 1 foot to 1.2 feet tall), and about 2.5 times the width of the figure (around 5 to 6 feet wide on each side).

notes: slightly taller than catalog expectation but remains low and wide
